propositions: test_perf asserts a fixed 50ms wall-clock budget on a single run of overlap.retrieve() over 300 digests, causing flaky failures under CI runner contention
the function's true cost is ~1.6ms median locally, but CI single samples reach 289.5ms due to transient scheduling, not algorithmic regression
measuring the minimum elapsed time across N≥5 runs (best-of-N) will filter transient contention while retaining ability to detect real performance regressions
the test must be updated to use best-of-N measurement instead of single-sample assertion to stabilize the Verified gate for unrelated changes
